Class WhoOneTimeTokenService

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.emaillink.WhoOneTimeTokenService
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.authentication.ott.OneTimeTokenService
public class WhoOneTimeTokenService extends Object implements org.springframework.security.authentication.ott.OneTimeTokenService
Spring Security OneTimeTokenService for email links.

generate(GenerateOneTimeTokenRequest) only creates a random value and touches no table, so it takes the same time whether or not the address is known; EmailLinkIssuer stores the token later, on another thread. consume(OneTimeTokenAuthenticationToken) is never used: EmailLinkAuthenticationProvider redeems sign-ins itself, by link token or by code.
